Arguments of `bandage_layout()` that the README and gallery use. `?bandage_layout`
lists the rest.

| Argument | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `walks` | Haplotypes to colour |
| `walks = list(list(walk = "HG01106#1", color = list(field = "pass")))` | A walk coloured by pass: each trip it makes round nodes it steps again takes its own colour and name. `bandage_pass_bar()` draws the passes along the walk |
| `facet = "walk"` | One panel per walk |
| `engine = "stress"` | Reference drawn straight, variants hanging off it. Default is Bandage's force-directed layout |
| `genes` | A GFF3 or BED file pinned onto the reference |
| `context = 30000` | On a walk file, 30 kb of reference past each end of `region`, so the drawing shows where straight reference meets the variation. Default: what the browser readers keep |
| `small_sites = "nodes"` | Every node and link drawn, however small at the figure's size. Default leaves out sites under 3 px of the drawn reference, as the browser readers do at overview; the key's last line counts them and the layout's `sites` table lists them |
| `bubbleSpread = "compress"` | Long and short nodes drawn nearer the mean length, so one long insertion doesn't fill the figure. Default draws length proportional to bp |
